name: Chamango Mango
notes: Photo 4 is a clearly printed 'Chamango Mango Deli' price flyer, used as the base. Photos 1-3 show in-store framed menu boards covering the same items but with prices partly covered by correction stickers, and some board prices (e.g. Tostilokos/Manzana Loka/Nachos Deluxe) are noticeably higher than the flyer, suggesting the boards are a more recent update; where boards were legible and higher, those figures were used. Raspados, Shakes, and Licuados y Chocomilk appear only on the boards (photo 2) and were added from there since the flyer omits their prices.
